caption: The drawing depicts a single, brown or dark-colored pitcher positioned centrally against a plain, light beige background. The pitcher has a curved body with a pronounced neck, a wide spout at the top, and a handle that loops from the upper part of the neck down to attach below the midsection of the vessel. The handle has a small, decorative curl at its lower attachment point. The lighting on the pitcher creates subtle highlights and reflections, indicating a glossy surface. There are no additional objects or elements in the drawing, and the composition is minimal, with ample empty space surrounding the central pitcher. In the lower right corner of the background, the name "JANET RIZA" is printed in uppercase letters. In the bottom left corner, there is a small, faint scale or ruler mark.
